verdict.label: STEP ASIDE — Brent Clears $90; Qatar Ceasefire Proposal Opens De-Escalation Path; July 22 GOOGL+TSLA Is the Week's Binary
verdict.rationale_short: Brent crude breached $90/bbl on Monday July 20 for the first time in this conflict — a new formal escalation level and $2 above Friday's $88.10 settlement — as Iran continued strikes on Kuwait and Bahrain for the ninth consecutive night. The counter-signal is the most substantive since July 8: Qatar proposed a 10-day ceasefire with Hormuz reopening, and Trump stated Iran is 'very, very badly damaged.' September hike probability compressed from 69% (Friday) to approximately 65%. Chipmakers are recovering pre-market (SMH +1%, AMD +2%+), and BTC is live at $64,420 with Gate 2 ($62,000) intact. STEP ASIDE at medium conviction — not BEARISH escalation — because the de-escalation path is now visible for the first time in 10 days, but WTI at $84.49 makes the formal BEARISH→STEP ASIDE upgrade conditions (WTI below $79 + SPX two consecutive closes above 7,480 + VIX below 17) impossible to meet today without a ceasefire agreement. July 22 GOOGL Q2 + TSLA Q2 + AMD AI Day is the week's defining binary event.

bear_case: Counter-thesis for upgrading to HOLD by mid-week: Qatar's ceasefire proposal could accelerate into a formal agreement before July 22. If Iran accepts the 10-day halt framework, WTI could gap below $80, collapsing the oil-shock CPI narrative and allowing September hike probability to fall below 50%. The chipmaker pre-market recovery (SMH +1%, Micron +3%, AMD +2%) is the market's forward bet on GOOGL and TSLA delivering on July 22 — a double-beat would directly refute the Kimi K3 demand-disruption thesis with live fundamental data from two independent AI vectors (Cloud monetization and Autonomy revenue). BTC at $64,420 with Gate 2 intact through five consecutive sessions of equity-market stress is the leading cross-asset indicator that broad risk appetite has not broken structurally. AAPL's sustained relative strength and the non-AI defensives (healthcare names up 9-10% last week) confirm rotation rather than broad capitulation. Invalidation: If WTI falls below $79 AND SPX closes above 7,480 for two consecutive sessions AND VIX compresses below 17, the STEP ASIDE call is wrong and HOLD/SELECTIVE should resume. As of this morning: WTI $84.49 — none of the three upgrade conditions are currently met.
